text:
sre-ana: noticing a sharp spike in 5xx for hosted inference gateway (/v1/generate) starting ~2026-03-17T11:03Z. customer escalations coming in. 5xx rate ~4.8% over last 5m, error mix: 503, upstream timeouts. adding logs and traces now.

infra-bot: deploy-monitor: canary rollout finished at 2026-03-17T11:00Z -> image: inference-service:v2.3-quantized-canary (12 pods)

dev-ryan: I saw a canary push that toggled a kernel-selection flag for int8 runtime at 10:58. could be regression for long-sequence kernels.

jason (oncall): any repro steps or trace ids? is it affecting only long seqs or all requests?

support-bridge: AcmeCorp and two other customers reported 503s on /v1/generate around 11:05. They said retries returned 503 as well. raising CS priority.

sre-ana: dropping a cropped log from edge -> backend:
```
2026-03-17T11:04:32Z edge LB: conn reset by peer -> upstream: inference-svc-canary-7
2026-03-17T11:04:33Z upstream timeout (1.5s) handler=generate seq_len=2048 trace=tx-3b9f
2026-03-17T11:04:34Z HTTP 503 gateway error - no healthy upstreams
```

dev-ryan: ok i'm going to shift traffic off the canary and roll back the kernel flag. recommend fallback mapping to non-quantized model for long sequences while we investigate.

mira.ops: applying temporary circuit-breaker for route `/v1/generate`: max_per_instance=20, burst=5, cool_down=30s. pushing policy now.

infra-bot: policy-applier: circuit-breaker applied to route /v1/generate at 2026-03-17T11:08Z

sre-ana: after CB + routing off canary, 5xx dropped to ~0.6% within 2m. latency for short seqs back to normal. still seeing a small tail of timeouts for >1500 token requests.

prod-emma: heads-up: notifying AE/CS for impacted customers and offering token credit. @support-bridge please take the customer comms and capture repro payloads.

support-bridge: drafting message to AcmeCorp now, will include our mitigation steps and ETA for full resolution.

dev-ryan: next actions for postmortem (quick list):
- revert canary kernel flag (ryan) -> DONE at 11:09Z
- add canary perf smoke for long sequences + random seed (qa-team) -> owner: qa, due: 2026-03-20 EOW
- increase autoscaler headroom for inference-pool and lower cooldown (mira.ops) -> due: 2026-03-18
- default per-route circuit-breaker sane limits (sre-ana) -> due: 2026-03-19
- add end-to-end canary rollback playbook to runbook (dev-ryan + mira.ops) -> due: 2026-03-19

sre-ana: i'll open a follow-up ticket with timeline, full logs, traces (tx-3b9f, tx-4c2a, tx-7dff) and assign owners as listed. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

infra-bot: incident-monitor: current 5xx rate 0.4% (1m avg). marking incident status: mitigated. Will auto-close if 5xx < 1% for 30m.

prod-emma: thanks all. please add any missing action items to the ticket. will coordinate customer updates.

support-bridge: sent initial message to AcmeCorp + two other customers with mitigation summary and token credit offer.

jason (oncall): if anything regresses ping me directly. otherwise reassign to Triage queue.

sre-ana: closing thread for now — reopening if 5xx climbs above 1% for 5m. :white_check_mark:
